10743.subject: English Language
10743.question_text:
Select the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence.

Imona couldn't have attended lectures yesterday
10743.explanation: The sentence "Imona couldn't have attended lectures yesterday" suggests a situation where it is unlikely or impossible for Imona to have attended lectures on the specified day. The word "couldn't" implies a strong negation or impossibility. Option A, "It was impossible that Imona attended lectures yesterday," is the correct interpretation. It reflects the idea that attending lectures yesterday is not a possible or likely scenario for Imona.

options.text: it was impossible that Imona attended lectures yesterday
It was possible that Imona didn't attend lectures yesterday
It was possible that Imona attended lectures yesterday
It was impossible that Imona didn't attend lectures yesterday
